title: Ni(II) porphine, singlet, RHF/def2-SVP
description: The smallest real metalloporphyrin: the Ni-PAP complex with every substituent removed. This is where correlation first extends off the metal into the macrocycle, which is the effect the Ni-PAP work found and the reason the active-space sweeps in benchmarks/sweep.py exist.

active_space.notes: The sweep here is the point of the entry: the Ni-PAP manuscript found correlation reaching past the nominal Ni 3d orbitals into the porphyrin framework, so the singlet-triplet splitting is expected to keep moving as the window grows. Use the same resolved window for both spin states.

provenance.geometry_source: benchmarks/geometries/ni_porphine.xyz, an idealised D4h model built by benchmarks/geometries/build_ni_porphine.py from standard metalloporphine bond lengths. Not optimised; optimise before quoting any number from it.
